name: fluid
summary: A clamp() value that grows with the viewport between two widths, then stops. The preferred value keeps a rem term rather than being pure vw, because a vw-only value ignores browser text zoom and fails WCAG 1.4.4. It is a function rather than a mixin because the value is the hard part and belongs to any property, not only font-size.

arguments.name: $min
accepts: a length in px or rem, the value at $min-viewport

arguments.name: $max
accepts: a length in px or rem, the value at $max-viewport, no smaller than $min

arguments.name: $min-viewport
accepts: a length in px or rem, the width below which the value stops shrinking

arguments.name: $max-viewport
accepts: a length in px or rem, larger than $min-viewport
